generalInfo.generalRule: All attendees (ages 3 and over) are required to purchase a full price ticket. The Depot has some of the best ways to view a show in the city! Please note there are NO refunds or exchanges unless an event is cancelled or postponed. Smoking is NOT permitted inside the building.
